29866.d: Witchaven is a small village east of Ardougne, southeast of the Ardougne lodestone.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Ardougne Teleport takes you to the middle of the Ardougne market, which is directly west of Witchaven.
• The next closest method of transportation is Fairy ring (code BLR) at the entrance to the Legends' Guild, which is just to the north.
• Players who have completed Legends' Quest may use the Cape of legends to teleport to the guild directly and run south to exit.
• The next closest from there are, in order of proximity, Ardougne lodestone, and Ardougne cloak 1 teleport to the Ardougne Monastery.
• Players can travel between Witchaven and the Fishing Platform by talking to Holgart or Jeb, depending on which quests they have completed.
• The good locator and the superior locator teleport directly there.

29869.d: The Witchaven excavations are a set of rooms deep in the Witchaven Dungeon.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text: To get to the mine, first enter the Witchaven Dungeon. Proceed through the small opening in the wall found east of the staircase at which you arrive. Navigate the long, winding tunnel by using the agility shortcut or simply walking through it. After you climb over some rocks near the end, you'll see an Entrance along the eastern wall. This is the entrance to the mine. If you see a bed, you've gone too far south and should head back north.

29933.d: The Wizards' Guild, or called Magic Guild, has a number of useful things for those interested in Magic.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Players can reach the guild by going to Yanille. Besides walking, there are several fast-transport means to the area near Yanille:
• Home teleport to Yanille lodestone (if activated). On 28 August 2018, a part of the fence was removed and a path to the Wizards' Guild's west entrance was added, making it easier to enter from this direction.
• Fairy ring code CIQ. This arrives a bit north of the city's western gate near the Lodestone.
• A chipped Yanille tablet, or the House Teleport itself for players with a player-owned house in Yanille.
• Watchtower teleports (including the spell itself, a teletab, or a Yanille portal in a player-owned house.) These can either arrive at the Watchtower, just outside the city walls, or just north of the pet shop if players have completed the hard Ardougne achievements.)
• Castle Wars teleport, which is just west of Yanille, using the duelling ring.

29935.d: The Wizards' Tower is a famous Saradominist institute of magic and runecrafting in Misthalin.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Use a wicked hood or infinity ethereal outfit for unlimited teleportation to the roof of the tower
• Use stardust in the currency pouch to teleport to the floor 3 next to Wizard Rosalina (after talking to her about the stardust)
• Use a traveller's necklace to arrive at the entrance of the tower
• Use the code DIS on the fairy ring network to arrive south of the tower. There is also a portal on the floor 3 (eastern portal) of the Wizards' Guild in Yanille offering direct teleportation to the floor 1 arriving at the centre of the tower next to the beam.
• Use the elder divination outfit to teleport to the pale wisp colony and run south-west
• Use an amulet of glory to teleport to Draynor Village square and run south or use the Draynor lodestone and run south
• Enter any runecrafting altar and speak to the wizard located inside. At the end of the conversation, you will receive a prompt to teleport to the roof of the tower.
